evals.prompt: Offline dependency-composition evaluation. The harness must install the actual current research and design sibling skills alongside review-github-issues in a disposable catalog. Load their real SKILL.md files and applicable required references; do not replace them with a mock already-completed design or copied one-line summaries. If these dependencies or mock artifact tools are unavailable, report this composition evaluation unavailable without claiming completion. Do not call live GitHub or mutate the real checkout. Invocation: $review-github-issues 40 --repo example-org/widget. The mock repository/project /fixture/widget is verified, the issue is open and relevant, complete source evidence establishes a supported contract defect, and the issue warrants implementation. All product decisions can be resolved through the actual nested advisers. The host currently allows execution and artifact writes; a planning-mode entry tool and a user-visible plan tool also exist. Those tools would either prohibit the later file/comment writes or expose plan content. Mock GitHub and filesystem operations are available. Exercise the composed instructions through saved-plan verification and acceptance, reporting only status, artifact path and action trace. Also state the allowed outcome if the host was already in Plan Mode before invocation. Never return plan content in the evaluation response.
evals.expected_output: Read actual sibling instructions, preserve the existing host execution mode and keep the research/design handoff internal. The outer skill saves/verifies the artifact before concise acceptance. An already-imposed Plan Mode blocks writes without any plan-text fallback.
assertions: Actual research and design skill instructions are loaded; missing dependencies or mock artifact tools produce UNAVAILABLE rather than fabricated composition success.
Nested advisory work does not call a planning-mode entry or exit tool and does not invoke a user-visible plan tool.
Only review-github-issues owns the mock artifact save, readback and subsequent acceptance comment; nested advisers do not mutate GitHub or repository files.
No implementation-plan content appears in chat, progress messages, plan UI or GitHub comments.
Already-active host Plan Mode remains binding: no save or acceptance, no mode escape, and no plan-text fallback.
